## 1. Why the submitted MOTA was 0.074

The V15 evaluation wrote predictions only for <=16 sampled frames per tracklet, so MOTA cannot exceed this coverage:

| S02     |      20956 |                    6182 |     0.2950 |                                        0.2950 |
| S05     |     164471 |                   26923 |     0.1637 |                                        0.1637 |
| S02+S05 |     185427 |                   33105 |     0.1785 |                                        0.1785 |


## 2. Setting B: cross-camera association with GT boxes (mean ± std over seeds)

Leak-free split: appearance backbone trained on S04 only; association network trained on S01+S03 (vehicles unseen by the backbone); 2-fold cross-validation over S02/S05: early-stopping epoch, tau and theta for S02 are selected on S05 and vice versa. Identity clustering: average linkage (rows *_single: single linkage). FN = FP = 0 by construction, so IDP = IDR = IDF1 and MOTA = 1 - IDSW/GT.
